Team,

- Latency: P95 has crept from 420ms -> 560ms on a low-volume tail (see sheet "latency_summary").

- Uptime: 99.96% for the month; one 18m blip on Aug 28 (incident tracked in JIRA-OPS-5232).
- Usage: Customer load spike from a new integration — sustained +22% week-over-week in the US region.

Ask: please review and reply with owners/action items by EOD Thursday (Sep 2):
- Latency root-cause owner and mitigation plan
- Cost line-item owner to finalize per-1M token calc for CFO slide
- Uptime remediation owner for the Aug 28 blip and RCA timeline
- Any blockers for QBR slide deck (I will consolidate)

I'll compile and send the QBR-ready 1-pager on Fri morning.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
SVP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Markus — thanks for the rollup and the spreadsheet. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Latency spike root cause (prelim): kernel fallback on one CUDA node after a microcode update; affected longer-sequence requests. See attached latency_trend_aug28.png for the P95/P99 ramp.
  - Action: request infra to pin driver/kernel on the affected pool and schedule a controlled re-run of the microcode in canary.
- Usage: the +22% is concentrated on a single customer integration (Acme Analytics). Usage pattern shows many medium-length chats, which hurts batching efficiency.
- Cost: storage kv churn is visible in the "cache_ops" column; we should separate persistent KV write frequency from read-mostly cache to model costs accurately.

Proposed owners:
- Latency RCA & mitigation: jonas_weber (infra) + markus_klein (deploy)
- Cost per-1M token calc: laura_bennett (finance-op analytics)
- Uptime RCA & follow-through: irene_choi (SRE)

I'll take the first pass on the latency slides and drop the P95/P99 plots into the Drive link.

Jonas
Director, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
